MiMo-V2.6-RL Music (Harbor)

FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-music

Compose one piece of music in ABC notation to a written brief.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • creative generation RL
  • feature-based scoring without a judge

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Xiaomi's scorer converts the ABC to MIDI and measures 18 human-likeness features; a validity gate zeroes invalid pieces.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

hf download FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-music --repo-type dataset --local-dir mimo-music
cd mimo-music
PYTHONPATH=agents HF_TOKEN=hf_... harbor run -y -c jobs/music.yaml

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-music --repo-type dataset --local-dir MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-music

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-music --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

4. Serve it for training with OpenEnvcommon pattern, not from this card

pip install "openenv[harbor]"
openenv harbor serve --dataset FineEnvs/MiMo-V2.6-RL-harbor-music --llm-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 --model <your-model>

Framework documentation: Harbor, OpenEnv. Needs: HF token; Docker or Daytona sandbox.
